answer: A2 (generated-ssot) is described here as a pipeline fixture, not as a live ADV dossier. A typed registry is the only hand-authored source. generate() is a pure function of registry bytes and generator_version. Two runs are byte-identical. Each generated file carries a provenance header with registry_entry_sha256.
